additional_info.subject: ID0467869-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R0 170002551] Fan runs continuously CRM:03209000022
additional_info.body:
Dear Felix,
I am following up about the ticket that was opened related to the charger; C4RAaL
I would like to receive some more information about what the issue is, and what the question is for us to support you the best we can.
After checking the charger i can`t find any errors that occurred.
Right now the charger is in a standby mode, and that is why the fans are running in the charger. The charger goes into a standby mode, when the charger is not in use.
Please provide me with information or feedback, so i can support you or close the ticket.
Thank you.
Best regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
eMobility Technical Support Team
